resources.string: Gadget lets you inspect every sensor and actuator on your Android device and wire them together with the Automation engine. Each module is self-contained; the rooted flavor unlocks deeper hardware access without changing the standard UI.
Proximity, light, accelerometer, gyroscope, and step counter. Every sensor streams live data and records history. Rooted builds can poll at higher rates.
Bluetooth, WiFi, NFC, and IR Blaster. Shows adapter state, connected devices, signal strength, and network details. IR can transmit NEC/Pronto/RAW codes.
Torch (flashlight) and Vibration are the primary actuators. The rooted flavor adds direct PWM control of the LRA and ERM motors for complex haptic patterns.
Battery health, GPS position, Storage volumes, Lock state, and Ambient light are all monitored here. Rooted builds add sysfs writes, live fuel-gauge data, and kernel diagnostics.
Build rules that connect any sensor reading or hardware event to an actuator action. Rules evaluate in real-time; the engine runs as a foreground service when active.

Install the rooted APK alongside the standard one. Every privileged operation passes through RootSafetyGate — it respects your per-feature opt-outs and the soft rate limiter. Nothing fires without your consent.
Every module with a continuous signal exposes a live chart and a scrollable history chart. Start a monitor session from the module screen; data persists across restarts.
